title: Employee home: my devices
interface: Extends base.html. Greeting with employee.display_name. Section 'Čeká na vaše potvrzení' listing overview.pending (asset_tag, brand, model, kind text 'převzetí'/'vrácení', and a link 'Potvrdit' to the confirmation page: the view passes `confirm_links` dict handover_id -> url; render `confirm_links[h.id]`). Section 'Moje zařízení' table from overview.assigned: asset_tag, {{asset.status}}, type, brand, model, serial_number, since started_at, protocol number with link /my/protocols/.pdf, and a form POST /my/assets//return with input note and button 'Vrátit'. Section 'Historie' from overview.history (protocol_number, kind, status, confirmed_at). Empty-state texts. Variables: employee, overview, confirm_links, user. Czech; the word 'potvr' must appear when something is pending.

uses.base: templates/base.html: Jinja layout with blocks title and content; header nav (Moje zařízení '/', for admins: /admin/assets, /admin/handovers, /admin/employees, /admin/audit), current user e-mail and a logout form POST /auth/logout; flashed messages via get_flashed_messages(with_categories=true); links /static/style.css
